_about: Few-shot exemplars for the test case generator. Stories and test cases come from 'Sample US-TC.xlsx' supplied by the user (sheets US1, TC1, US2, TC2). The user's rows had TC ID, Description, Test Data, Actual Result, Expected Result and Status. They were converted to the BRD 12.2 format (+ Test Data) by hand: Steps, Risk, Priority and Evidence were written from each row's description and test data, using UI labels observed on the live site on 2026-09-27 (Username, Password, Login button, Products page, Add to cart, cart icon). Actual Result is not carried over: it is filled in when the test runs.

_corrections.text: TC-LOGIN-008 test data reads " OR '1'='1" in the spreadsheet. Excel treats a leading apostrophe as a text marker and hides it, so the intended value is "' OR '1'='1".

story.title: User Login
story.text:
User Story 1 — User Login
As a registered user
I want to log in to the website using valid credentials
So that I can access the application.

steps: Verify the Products page is displayed
cases.expected_result: User successfully logs in and is redirected to the Products page

cases.objective: Reject login with an invalid password
steps: Verify an error message is displayed
Verify the user remains on the login page
cases.expected_result: Login fails and an appropriate error message is displayed

cases.objective: Reject login with an invalid username
steps: Verify an error message is displayed
cases.expected_result: Login fails and an appropriate error message is displayed

cases.objective: Require username and password before login
steps: Leave the Username and Password fields blank
Verify a validation message is displayed
cases.expected_result: Validation/error message is displayed and login is not completed

cases.objective: Mask the password as it is typed
preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: Enter `<any password>` in the Password field
Verify the Password field shows masked characters
cases.expected_result: Password is displayed as masked characters

cases.objective: Block login for a locked-out user
steps: Verify a locked-out error message is displayed
cases.expected_result: Login is blocked and an appropriate locked-out user error message is displayed

cases.objective: Prevent access to the Products page without logging in
steps: Verify the Products page is not displayed
Verify the user is redirected to the login page or access is denied
cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page or access is denied

steps: Enter `' OR '1'='1` in the Username field
Verify an error message is displayed
Verify the Products page is not displayed
cases.expected_result: Login fails safely and no unauthorized access is granted

story.title: Add Product to Cart
story.text:
As a logged-in user
I want to add a product to my shopping cart
So that I can purchase the selected product.

cases.objective: Add a single product to the cart
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Products page
steps: Click Add to cart on one product
cases.expected_result: Selected product is added and cart count becomes 1

cases.objective: Add multiple products to the cart
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Products page
steps: Click Add to cart on `<number of products>` different products
Verify the cart count equals the number of products added
cases.expected_result: All selected products are added and cart count reflects the correct quantity

cases.objective: Show correct product details in the cart
preconditions: A product has been added to the cart
steps: Verify the product name matches the product added
Verify the product price matches the product added
cases.expected_result: Cart displays the correct product name, price, and quantity

cases.objective: Remove a product from the cart
preconditions: A product exists in the cart
steps: Verify the product is no longer listed
Verify the cart count is updated
cases.expected_result: Product is removed and cart count is updated correctly
evidence_requirements: Screenshot of the cart before and after removal

cases.objective: Keep cart contents after navigating away
preconditions: A product has been added to the cart
steps: Navigate away from the cart to the Products page
Verify the product is still listed with correct details
cases.expected_result: Selected product remains in the cart with correct details
